## What's new

- **A real installer.** Download **r2backup-setup.exe** (or
  **r2backup-setup-arm64.exe** on Arm PCs) and run it. It installs r2backup
  for your Windows account without asking for admin rights, adds it to the
  Start menu, starts it when you sign in, and can put `r2b` on your PATH.
  Running it again updates or reinstalls, and r2backup shows up in
  Settings > Apps so you can remove it from there. It downloads the newest
  release and checks it against the published checksums before installing.
- **Updates when you open r2backup.** Each time you open the panel from the
  tray, r2backup checks for a newer version. If one is out, it asks
  whether to update. Click **Update now** and it replaces itself and
  restarts, with no need to download anything yourself. It won't ask
  while a backup is running.

## Fixed

- **The panel kept saying a removed folder "was interrupted".** If a folder's
  backup was cut off and you then removed the folder, the panel went on showing
  "<folder> was interrupted" with a Carry on button that did nothing. Removing a
  folder now clears what its cut-off backup left behind, and the panel ignores
  any interrupted backup whose folder is gone. With no folders left, it goes back
  to "Add a folder to start".

- **Automatic backups stayed on with nothing to back up.** Removing your last
  folder now turns the schedule off, so it no longer runs for nothing. It stays
  on if you copy Drime folders to your S3 storage, since the schedule does that.
